title: pcf-casoratian-catalogue: A machine-verified higher-order (order ≥ 3, uniform in k) Casoratian law for linear recurrences — the Abel–Jacobi–Liouville identity C(n+1) = (−1)^(k−1) c₀(n) C(n) in Lean 4 / Mathlib
description:
The higher-order (order ≥ 3) Casoratian law for a homogeneous linear recurrence, formalized to a clean axiom cone in Lean 4 / Mathlib. For the order-k recurrence s(n+k) = ∑j=0k−1 cj(n) s(n+j), the order-k Casoratian (the k×k discrete Wronskian of k solutions) C(n) = det[ s(t)(n+i) ]0≤i,t<k obeys the first-order Abel–Jacobi–Liouville law C(n+1) = (−1)k−1 c0(n) C(n), hence the closed product form C(n) = ( ∏m<n (−1)k−1 c0(m) ) C(0). Only the lowest coefficient c0 survives; c1 … ck−1 cancel. At k = 2 the sign is the corpus −c0; at k = 3 it flips to +c0. The (−1)k−1 sign is now established as a single uniform theorem over all k, not merely the k = 2, 3 instances.

Why it matters. The deposited corpus formalized only order-2 (three-term) Casoratians; this is the first order-≥3 result. The higher-order Casoratian is the algebraic backbone of simultaneous / Hermite–Padé approximation — the engine of Apéry-type irrationality proofs.

Contents (catalogue entry C1). Twenty-six Lean theorems across three namespaces. The uniform-in-k core (namespace PcfGeneralCaso, GeneralCaso.lean): casoMat_det_step (the general step C(n+1) = (−1)k c0(n) C(n) for the order-(k+1) Casoratian, proved by rewriting the last row via the recurrence into a combination of the cyclically rotated rows of C(n) — Matrix.det_updateRow_sum collapses it to the c0 coefficient and sign_finRotate supplies the cyclic sign), casoMat_det_eq (uniform closed product form), casoMat_det_eq_const (constant-c0 power form), and casoMat_det_ne_zero_of_init (integral-domain non-degeneracy at all k). The by-hand low-order witnesses (namespace PcfHigherCaso): caso3_step (the order-3 step law), caso3_eq (closed product form), caso3_eq_const (constant-c0 case C(n)=c0n C(0)), caso3_ne_zero_of_init (a non-degeneracy / linear-independence certificate over an integral domain), and caso2_step (the order-2 sign −c0 recovered as a faithfulness witness), and caso3_matches_general (a bridge proving the bespoke 3×3 caso3 equals det of the general casoMat at k=2, reconciling the minimal-cone witnesses with the formalized general theorem). The fundamental-system converse (namespace PcfGeneralCaso): sol_unique_of_init (forward determinacy — a solution is pinned by its first k values, no invertibility needed) and solution_isLinearCombo (completeness — once the initial Casoratian is a unit, every solution is an R-linear combination of the basis), so the solutions form a machine-checked fundamental set. A Hermite–Padé / Apéry irrationality pipeline (namespace PcfHermitePade, HermitePade.lean): caso_mulVec_apply (a linear form's window equals C(n) times its coefficient vector), linForm_window_ne_zero and linForm_frequently_ne_zero (a nontrivial form cannot vanish on a full window, hence is frequently nonzero), irrational_of_linearForm_frequently (the linear-form irrationality criterion), and the capstone irrational_of_fundamentalSet_form (an integer fundamental set plus a shrinking real remainder ⇒ irrationality, the non-vanishing discharged structurally by the Casoratian). Two concrete order-3 witnesses close the pipeline: a geometric set {1, 2n, 3n} with explicit Casoratian C(n) = 2·6n (gcaso_ne_zero, geom_window_ne_zero), and the golden-ratio certificate on u(n+3) = 2u(n+2) − u(n) — fundamental set {1, Fn, Fn+1}, Cassini initial Casoratian 1 (fibCaso0, fibCaso_ne_zero), shrinking remainder Fnφ − Fn+1 = −ψn → 0 (fib_remainder_tendsto) — yielding goldenRatio_irrational_via_caso: φ is irrational, an independent Casoratian route (Mathlib's own proof is √5-based; no novelty is claimed for φ's irrationality, only for the reusable machine-checked pipeline). A sympy gate (harness_caso_k.py): a fully symbolic proof at k=3 plus exact-rational verification k=2..7 plus named instances (the Tribonacci recurrence c0≡1 → constant Casoratian; c0(n)=n+1 → C(n)=n! C(0)).

Epistemic status (SIARC four-class) — PROVEN. Each of the twenty-six theorems was rechecked from source with lake env lean Check.lean under the pinned leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0 + Mathlib v4.30.0 toolchain: every axiom cone is a subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} (the two _step lemmas need only {propext, Quot.sound}), with no sorryAx and no sorry/admit/native_decide in source. The Lean core is built and cone-checked inside the companion pcf-delta PcfContinuant project, where it is cross-listed in Check.lean alongside the order-2 general Casoratian (casoratian_eqG).

Open / next (CONJECTURED). A concrete simultaneous-Hermite–Padé PCF whose order-3 Casoratian drives the now-proven pipeline to the irrationality of a constant not already known to be irrational — an Apéry-style (ζ(3)-type) certificate rather than the golden-ratio demonstration. Both items previously listed open here are now PROVEN: the (−1)k−1 uniform-k sign theorem (casoMat_det_step) and the fundamental-system converse (sol_unique_of_init, solution_isLinearCombo), and the irrationality pipeline itself is now machine-checked end-to-end on the golden ratio (goldenRatio_irrational_via_caso); what remains is to exhibit a target recurrence whose shrinking remainder yields a new irrationality theorem.
